raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and the pipeline does not normalize them. Evening v2 transactions shift past midnight in UTC, which creates the spurious 00:00-06:00 timestamps and moves them into the next business date, causing the 2026-01-19 volume drop.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') s;"}}
